comment: Which index a per-slot project setting vector is addressed by. Taken from the Snapmaker Orca source, not inferred from vector lengths.

evidence: src/libslic3r/Preset.cpp s_Preset_filament_options lists nozzle_temperature, nozzle_temperature_initial_layer, nozzle_temperature_range_high and nozzle_temperature_range_low: they are filament-preset options, one entry per filament.
src/libslic3r/Preset.cpp s_Preset_printer_options lists z_hop_types and z_hop_when_prime: printer-preset options, one entry per extruder.

src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp declares z_hop with the printer extruder retraction group (retraction_length, z_hop, z_hop_types, ...); a filament only overrides it through the separate filament_z_hop key (Preset.cpp filament options).
source.method: Read from the committed source files; no printer and no slicer run. Not measured in a running Snapmaker Orca.
